metrics.paid_help: Chat budget after spending and active reservations. Last request shows confirmed cost.
metrics.free_help: This chat’s token budget after usage and active reservations. Last request includes input and response tokens.
metrics.key_help: The {provider} key’s spending cap. Account balance and chat budget are separate amounts.
metrics.key_not_set_help: No separate key cap. Available account funds still apply.
metrics.key_unavailable_help: Refresh the key status from the menu.
metrics.without_confirmation_help: Skip ordinary paid-request confirmations in this chat, starting with the first request. Current model prices apply. Unknown prices require separate consent. Budget warnings and limits remain active.
estimate.empty: Enter a message for an estimate
estimate.help: Local estimate for the sent history and response limit. Actual token usage and cost may differ.
estimate.router_help: Local estimate for the sent history and response limit. The free router selects the model after sending.
metrics.account_help: Account snapshot from {provider}. Refresh it from the key menu. Billing may appear later.
budget_warning.title: Chat budget is running low
budget_warning.help: Estimate for this chat including history, response limit and reservations. Projected remaining budget is at most 10% of its limit.
budget_warning.exceed: This request may exceed the chat spending limit. Send permits this request once. Your saved limit will not change.
budget_warning.empty: This request may use up the chat spending limit.
budget_warning.draft_changed: The draft changed. Review it and send again.
